core.title: Universal Commercial Door Stop, Global TH1100-UDS

text.description_html:
Global TH1100-UDS, Satin Chrome Universal Door Stop

The TH1100-UDS Universal Commercial Door Stop is so called because the low base profile and the large bumper area makes this doorstop a good choice for most doors whether they have low clearance, high clearance, or anything in between. It has a Satin Chrome finish; and this commercial grade door stop features a spring loaded rubbed bumper. Easy installation and it come packaged with all the necessary mounting hardware.

Specifications of the TH1100-UDS Commercial Grade Universal Door Stop :

  • Overall Height: 1-1/2"
  • Diameter: 1-7/8"
  • Finish: Satin Chrome
  • Bumper Color: Gray
  • Material: Zinc

Sold Individually
